mentions.name: Specialized 3D metal printing slicer
mentions.description: A specialized slicer for a new 3D metal printing process, focusing on material safety, model accuracy, and making the technology affordable for hobbyist budgets.
mentions.problem: 3D metal printing has material safety and model accuracy issues, and the technology is typically out of reach of hobby budgets.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on a specialized slicer for a new 3D metal printing process. Mostly addresses material safety, model accuracy, and bringing technology within hobby budgets.

evidence.value: Still working on a specialized slicer for a new 3D metal printing process. Mostly addresses material safety, model accuracy, and bringing technology within hobby budgets.
